Weird and comfy! A peculiar world filled with mystical yet cozy and adorable creatures. Don't bother them, they're deep in their quirky vibes. Go ahead, gently splash your colors and let the fun begin!

This book offers:

  • 40 hand-drawn pages ready for coloring
  • Super cute and spooky coloring pages for stress relief and relaxation
  • Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through (if using markers, remember to place a protective sheet behind the page you're coloring)
  • A convenient size of 8.5 x 8.5 inches for easy handling
  • High-resolution prints for clear, crisp images.

HI! I'm Jeanett Veronica, a creator deeply in love with the art of coloring. For me, the true essence of relaxation lies in the simplicity of coloring books. I believe there's something incredibly soothing about filling bold, uncomplicated designs with color—it's my go-to method for unwinding and tapping into a state of peace.

Inspired by my search for serenity amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, I've dedicated myself to designing coloring books that reflect this philosophy. My collections are created with the hope of providing a tranquil escape for anyone in need of a stress-free creative outlet. Each page is a canvas for your imagination, requiring nothing but your favorite coloring tools and a desire to relax.

Join me in this colorful journey and discover the joy of easy, simple coloring. Let's bring some calm to our days, one page at a time.

Happy coloring,

Jeanett Veronica

Hi there, we're Coco Wyo, a group of artists and coloring lovers with a simple dream: to create little cozy moments (and maybe a smile) through coloring books.

Life can get busy, and we all need a small pause to connect with ourselves and with others.

Each page is drawn with love, meant to warm the heart and sometimes spark a sweet memory.

So whenever things feel overwhelming, think of this as your cozy corner - a place to color, breathe and slow down for a bit.

New Coloring Book for Christmas in 2026

Adults can relax and enjoy the magical holiday season with this festive and fun Christmas coloring book! A perfect way to unwind, celebrate Christmas, and enjoy peaceful creative time. Large Print Illustrations: Each design is printed in a large format for easy and comfortable coloring, allowing you to enjoy every festive detail without straining your eyes.
